notes: Six Normal-types leaning on Kanto bulk: Snorlax, Blissey and Tauros carry, Porygon2 and Kangaskhan support.
All-Fire team: every FRLG Fire-type worth using, Sunny Day support from Ninetales.
All-Water team with Rain Dance support for Kingdra and a Curse Lapras.
All-Grass team: sleep powders everywhere and Sunny Day Chlorophyll sweepers.
All-Electric team; Magneton and Lanturn cover each other, everyone paralyzes.
All-Ice team with Hail from Walrein-less Kanto: Lapras, Cloyster, Dewgong, Jynx, Piloswine, Sneasel.
All-Fighting team: five Kanto brawlers and Heracross, Hitmontop with Intimidate.
All-Poison team: Gengar, Weezing and Muk are real, the rest is for the theme.
All-Ground team: Earthquake six times over, Quagsire and Nidoqueen bring the coverage.
All-Flying team: Zapdos and Aerodactyl lead, Skarmory Spikes, Crobat, Dodrio, Pidgeot.
All-Psychic team: Alakazam and Starmie go fast, Slowbro and Hypno stall.
All-Bug team: Scizor, Heracross and Forretress carry the weaker Kanto bugs.
All-Rock team: Tyranitar summons sand, every one of them has Rock Slide.
All-Ghost team: every Gen 3 Ghost line that FireRed can hold, Shedinja included.
All-Dragon team: Dragonite, Kingdra, Salamence, Flygon, Altaria and a Dragonair for purity.
All-Dark team: Tyranitar and Houndoom hit, Umbreon walls, Sneasel and Murkrow annoy.
All-Steel team: Skarmory and Forretress stack Spikes while Metagross and Scizor clean.
Level-50 all-Water team for the Battle Tower style cap.
Only Pokemon that appear on Route 1: Pidgey and Rattata lines, three each.
Only Viridian Forest Pokemon: Caterpie and Weedle lines plus the forest Pikachu.
Only Mt. Moon Pokemon: Clefairy, Zubat, Geodude, Paras lines and the two fossils.
Only Safari Zone catches: Kangaskhan, Scyther, Pinsir, Chansey, Tauros and a Dratini grown into Dragonite.
Only Power Plant Pokemon: Electric-types from the abandoned plant, capped by Zapdos.
Only Cerulean Cave residents: Mewtwo and the strong wild things that live around it.
Six Ditto, six different held items; the only move on the team is Transform.
Three Ditto and three fateful Mew: Mew learns Transform at level 10, so the team copies whatever it sees.
Metronome and nothing else on six mons; Serene Grace Togetic makes the random flinches worse.
Metronome users that keep one real move each to survive long enough to roll a good one.
Three Wobbuffet and three Wynaut: Shadow Tag traps you, Counter and Mirror Coat do the rest.
Six level-100 Magikarp that only know Splash: perfectly legal, perfectly hopeless.
Magikarp that actually attack: Flail off a Salac Berry, with a Feebas and a Wynaut for company.
Six freshly-bought level-5 Magikarp from the Mt. Moon salesman, Splash only.
Trick team: Choice Bands and Macho Braces get handed to the opponent by Alakazam, Mr. Mime and Kecleon.
Item-removal team: Knock Off, Thief and Covet on everything, most of them holding nothing so Thief actually steals.
Six Smeargle that only know Sketch: they have to copy the opponent mid-battle to do anything at all.
Six Smeargle with pre-Sketched movesets (Spore, Belly Drum, Baton Pass, Spikes, Sheer Cold...); real in FRLG but the checker only credits Sketch itself, so it reads as encodable.
Shedinja and Wonder Guard: Rapid Spin support, cleric Blissey, and walls that beat the six types that hurt it.
Six Shedinja: one HP each, Wonder Guard on all of them, and hopefully no Sandstorm.
Six Unown, all Hidden Power only, with IVs tuned to six different Hidden Power types.
All-legendary Ubers team: Mewtwo, Lugia, Ho-Oh, Kyogre, Groudon, Rayquaza.
Every legendary FireRed itself hands out: the three birds, Mewtwo, event Mew and Deoxys.
Six freshly hatched babies at level 5: Pichu, Cleffa, Igglybuff, Togepi, Smoochum, Elekid.
Unevolved babies raised to level 100 with all their egg moves and TMs.
Tyrogue and its three Hitmons plus Magby and Elekid: the punch-and-kick nursery.
Attract, Swagger and Confuse Ray on everything: win by making the opponent hit itself.
Paraflinch: Thunder Wave then Serene Grace Body Slam / Headbutt / Bite, plus Quick Claw and Bright Powder.
Double Team, Minimize and Sand Veil plus Bright Powder: an evasion team no honest player enjoys facing.
Doubles: Fake Out to buy a turn, then Explosion or Self-Destruct on everything that has it.
Doubles: everyone spams Earthquake while the partner is Levitate, Flying or a Skarmory.
Doubles: Follow Me Clefable and Togetic redirect while Plusle and Minun Helping Hand the sweepers.
Doubles: Skill Swap partners hand their ability to Slaking to get rid of Truant, and swap Wonder Guard onto Shedinja... or away from it.
Sleep spam with 100% accurate Spore where possible, Sleep Powder elsewhere.
Hypnosis into Dream Eater or Nightmare on everything that can do it.
Sunny Day team: Ninetales and Charizard set it, Chlorophyll Grass-types abuse Solar Beam.
Rain Dance team: Swift Swim Kingdra, Ludicolo and Omastar sweep under rain with Thunder support.
Sandstorm team: Tyranitar sets it, Sand Veil Dugtrio and Cacturne dodge, Rock and Steel-types ignore it.
Hail team: Walrein, Glalie and Regice keep it snowing and spam perfectly accurate Blizzard.
Perish Song plus Mean Look or Shadow Tag: every mon traps and counts the opponent down.
Substitute down to a Salac Berry, then Endeavor, Flail or Reversal at full power.
Ghost-type Curse on every mon (Cursed Body does not exist in Gen 3, so the move has to do): halve your HP to bleed theirs.
